items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I just heard a fantastic set of music with some of your cohorts, Dan Barrett and Howard Alden. ... We haven’t worked together in a long time.

ctx.x: Frank was interviewed in Clearwater Beach, Florida on March 18, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Clearwater Beach. I’m really pleased to have bassist Frank Tate with me here today. And I just heard a fantastic set of music with some of your cohorts, Dan Barrett and Howard Alden.
I’d have to share your enthusiasm for it. We haven’t worked together in a long time.
